concerns.text: FR-003 does not define how a parameter is considered “appearing in the docstring”. Is the match exact token, case‑insensitive, substring, or based on lemmatization? Without a precise matching rule the coverage score cannot be deterministically computed.

FR-010 mentions “stratified sampling across at least three popularity tiers (high, medium, low) … each tier contributes ≥ 5 repositories” but does not specify how tiers are quantified (e.g., download count thresholds, percentile ranges). The lack of concrete tier boundaries makes the sampling procedure non‑reproducible.

FR-011 defines Description Coverage Score as “average number of non‑stop‑word tokens per documented parameter (excluding the parameter name itself)”, yet it does not specify the tokenisation method, which stop‑word list to use, or how to handle punctuation and multi‑word parameters. This ambiguity prevents reliable measurement.

SC-005 states “Description Coverage Score ≥ 5 tokens per parameter for ≥ 80 % of methods indicates satisfactory narrative completeness” but does not clarify whether the 80 % is computed over the entire dataset, per repository, or per‑tier, nor how rounding should be handled. The metric is therefore under‑specified.
